name: Mossy Megaphone Grove
description: A forest clearing with giant vintage megaphones overgrown by moss, broadcasting birdsong through the trees.
prompt: A single mysterious yet gentle forest scene where giant vintage brass megaphones lie half-buried among moss, ferns, and wildflowers. Tiny birds perch on the rims, and soft rings of sound ripple through the air as golden pollen. Dappled sunlight, ancient trees, emerald and brass palette, magical realism, high detail, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
caption: If the forest could speak through old megaphones, what would it say first?
